capabilities: Render jps code blocks and .jps files as SVG jianpu
Play back scores with Web Audio synthesis
Edit scores in a built-in iJipu editor
Adjust page layout by dragging guide lines
Add watermarks and background images to pages
extras: First playback downloads a ~32 MB GeneralUser GS SoundFont from a GitHub link and caches it locally; a local .sf2 can be imported instead. No telemetry or account. The desktop-only built-in editor is served from a temporary 127.0.0.1 HTTP server with a one-time token. Licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later.
problem: Obsidian cannot display or play jianpu (numbered notation) scores, so score source and rendered sheet music cannot live together in a note.

relations.evidence: 渲染引擎复用 @ijipu/engine（与 iJipu 应用一致），设置项与 iJipu 一脉传承
特别致谢「番茄简谱」原作与社区

summary: Renders .jps jianpu scripts from code blocks or files as SVG sheet music with playback, and edits scores in a built-in editor on desktop.
